title: Long Text Translator
description: Import TXT or Markdown, or paste text. Compare source and translation segment by segment and edit as it translates.

library.title: Documents
library.empty: Imported documents are kept on this computer, so you can continue translating after closing the app.
library.unavailable_newer: Created by a newer version; can’t be opened

import.drop_title: Drop TXT or Markdown files here
import.drop_hint: Select one or more files. Each file becomes a document, up to 10 MB each.
import.drop_label: Release to import into Long Text Translator
import.privacy: When translating, the source text is sent to the selected model service. API keys are never written to disk.
import.large: {{name}} is large and may take a few seconds to open.

reason.unsupported_format: format not supported yet; save it as TXT or Markdown
reason.subtitle_file: translate subtitle files in Subtitle Studio
reason.binary_file: doesn’t look like a text file
reason.too_many_segments: more than 200,000 segments; split the file first
reason.limit_exceeded: document limit of 200 reached; delete documents you no longer need

filter.label: Show
filter.empty_edited: You haven’t edited any segments yet.
filter.next: Next item to review (N or F8)
filter.wrapped: Back to the first item to review

run.sample_tip: Translate the opening first, about 800 tokens (up to 12 segments), to see how it reads
run.stop_now_tip: Requests already sent may still be billed
run.no_model: No model is set up for translation yet

status.throttled: Rate limited by the service; lanes reduced to {{lanes}}

reader.page_picker_placeholder: Type a page number or chapter title
reader.page_picker_more: Keep typing to narrow the list

row.busy: This segment is being translated. Try again in a moment.
row.conflict: This segment just changed, so the latest version was kept.

editor.hint: Ctrl+Enter to save · Esc to cancel · Alt+↓ to save and edit the next segment

retranslate.title: Retranslate this segment
retranslate.placeholder: Extra instructions (optional), e.g. a lighter tone

chip_text.literal: Stay closer to the structure and wording of the source.

flags.length_short: Possibly incomplete: the translation is much shorter than the source ({{ratio}})
flags.length_long: The translation is much longer than the source and may contain extra content ({{ratio}})
flags.untranslated: The translation still contains a lot of source-language text
flags.term_missing_more: Glossary terms not used: {{source}} → {{target}} and {{count}} more
flags.placeholder_repaired: Formatting marks were repaired automatically; check the placement of {{kinds}}
flags.markup_missing: Links or code from the source are missing after your edit: {{items}}

failure.protocol_invalid: Not translated: the model returned an invalid format
failure.too_long: Not translated: this segment exceeds the response limit
failure.content_filtered: Not translated: the model declined to translate this segment
failure.budget_required: Not translated: the required materials don’t fit in one request
failure.empty_output: Not translated: the model returned nothing

notices.model_missing: No model is set up for translation yet.
notices.model_fallback: The original model was deleted, so the task model is used instead
notices.encoding_low: The encoding may have been detected incorrectly: it was read as {{encoding}}. If the source looks garbled, change the encoding.
notices.sample_done: Sample finished. If you like it, translate the whole document, or adjust the settings and try another sample.
notices.sample_again: Sample again with the new settings
notices.unstable_output: The model’s output kept failing the checks, so translation stopped to avoid wasting credit
notices.storage_failed: Couldn’t save translations: the disk is full or not writable.
notices.interrupted: Translation was interrupted when the app closed. Finished segments are saved ({{count}}).
notices.deferred: Some segments were held back because the model’s output was unstable ({{count}}). Select “Continue translating” to try again.
notices.run_done_failed: Translation finished, but some segments couldn’t be translated ({{count}}).
notices.knowledge_unavailable: The selected translation materials can’t be used: a collection was archived or deleted, or is for a different language direction.
notices.journal_issues: Some records couldn’t be read and were skipped ({{count}}). The affected segments may need to be translated again.
notices.background: Long text translation is still running in the background

settings.title: Translation settings
settings.running_note: Translation is running: changes apply from the next batch, and a model change applies the next time you start.
settings.same_language: The source and target languages are the same
settings.model_missing_key: The selected model has no API key.
settings.model_invalid: The selected model’s settings are incomplete.
settings.pace_help: Each chapter is always translated in order; more lanes translate more chapters at the same time.
settings.instructions_placeholder: For example: a school light novel with casual dialogue; use the common English spelling of names.
settings.batch_tokens_help: The most source tokens in one request. Larger batches need fewer requests, but the model is more likely to skip text.
settings.max_output_help: How many tokens the model may output per request. Thinking models need a larger value.
settings.language_change_warning: This document already has {{language}} translations ({{count}}). Changing the language clears all of them, including locked segments.
settings.structure_change_warning: This document already has translations ({{count}}). Changing paragraph detection clears all of them.

run_confirm.title: Translate the whole document?
run_confirm.body: This translates {{count}} segments and will use about {{tokens}} tokens{{cost}}. You can pause at any time, and finished segments are saved. The source text is sent to “{{model}}”.

export.title: Export translation
export.bilingual_note: Each source segment is followed by its translation; code blocks and similar content stay as they are.
export.no_overwrite: If a file with this name exists, a number is added. Nothing is overwritten.
export.incomplete: Some segments aren’t translated yet ({{count}}); the export keeps their source text.
export.running: Translation is still running; the export contains the progress so far.

ledger.title: Glossary
ledger.empty: Once translation starts, the names and terms the model notes appear here. You can also add them yourself.
ledger.note: Confirmed terms are always used, and translations are checked against them. Unconfirmed ones were noted by the model while translating and keep the wording consistent. Changes only affect later translations; use “Retranslate from here” to refresh earlier ones.
ledger.save_needs_confirmed: Confirm the terms you want to save first

encoding.title: Encoding
encoding.label: Encoding
encoding.has_translations: Changing the encoding clears the existing translations ({{count}}).

confirm.delete_body: The translations, edits and glossary of “{{name}}” will be deleted. The original file and exported files are not affected.
confirm.clear_body: Translations to clear: {{count}}. You can undo each segment separately.
confirm.from_here_body: Unlocked translations in the {{count}} segments from segment {{ordinal}} onward will be cleared and translated again. Locked segments are kept.

errors.busy: This document is being translated; pause it first
errors.conflict: The settings were changed elsewhere; open them again

errors.source_missing: The original file was moved or deleted
errors.source_changed: The original file has changed; import it again
errors.translations_exist: Translations exist and need to be cleared first
errors.same_language: The source and target languages are the same
errors.model_context_too_small: The selected model’s context window is too small (8K minimum)
errors.unstable_output: The model’s output kept failing the checks
errors.knowledge_unavailable: Translation materials can’t be read right now
errors.knowledge_invalid: The selected translation materials can’t be used for this document
errors.storage_failed: Couldn’t save: the disk is full or not writable
errors.destination_unavailable: Can’t write to this folder; choose another one
errors.name_exhausted: Too many files with this name; choose another folder
errors.file_too_large: The file is larger than 10 MB
errors.subtitle_file: Translate subtitle files in Subtitle Studio
errors.binary_file: This doesn’t look like a text file
errors.too_many_segments: Too many segments; split the file first
